title: Privacy Regulation and Fintech Lending
authors: Sebastian Doerr; Leonardo Gambacorta; Luigi Guiso; Marina Sánchez del Villar
eligible_reason: Single treated state at a single date: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA, effective 2020). Main specifications are triple differences caFTpost = California x fintech lender x post (with cid#lid, cid#year, fintech#year FE and loan controls); Figure event study xd1-xd4 = California x fintech x year. One adoption cohort, so not staggered.
design_notes: replication/MS.do on data/HMDA_2018_2021_final.dta: reghdfe interest_rate_w/denied/sdrate/... caldpost FTpost caFTpost (+ $controls), a(cid#lid [cid#year lender_is_fintech#year $fe]), cluster(coid); heterogeneity by race/income, credit-score interactions, ppmlhdfe applications/originations, GSE loan-level Table 8, COVID and house-price robustness.
